verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator documents a feature to export saved passwords (docs-10, docs-14) and cloud/iCloud backup of accounts (docs-9, docs-13, docs-19), giving some data portability, but there is no evidence that TOTP secrets/account data can be exported in an open standard format, and community reports note the app uses non-standard QR codes that lock users into the MS ecosystem (comm-6) rather than open, portable formats. missing for 10: export of TOTP/account secrets in open formats, confirmation that exported password format is open/interoperable, evidence of a full data-export-and-leave workflow.
